name: shared-module-group-unknown
summary: A shared module's group names an aggregate or read model of its domain.
explanation: This is this repo's own check. A shared module's group is the heading it is listed under in its domain, and it says whose code the module is: the aggregate or read model that uses it. A group that names neither is a heading made up only to keep a count down, which hides whose code it is. Set the group to the title of the aggregate or read model of the module's domain whose code it is, or clear it.
query:
SELECT m.id AS record,
       'Shared module ' || m.id || ' (' || m.title || ') is listed under "' || m.group_name || '", which is not the title of an aggregate or read model of domain ' || m.domain_id || '; name the aggregate or read model whose code it is.' AS message
FROM shared_module m
WHERE m.group_name IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aggregate a WHERE a.domain_id = m.domain_id AND a.title = m.group_name)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM read_model r WHERE r.domain_id = m.domain_id AND r.title = m.group_name)
ORDER BY record, message
